text: Appeal of Order to Comply (August 30, 2018) for 6 Walmer Road.

That the Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated August 30, 2018, regarding the property located at 6 Walmer Road, Folder No. 18 217629 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to November 1, 2019.
